title: SCRUM-77: PwD - View Product Card (Preview Summary) - Accessibility Test Plan
overview: Accessibility test plan for product card preview: image ALT text, semantic HTML (h3 for name, list for features), bookmark/save icon aria-label and keyboard toggle, card focusable with Enter to open details, focus outlines ≥3:1, screen reader announces name/rating/availability/link role, 200% zoom without overlap, no context change on hover/focus, linear keyboard navigation.

testCases.title: Product card image has ALT text
steps: Verify alt attribute present and descriptive

testCases.title: Product name uses h3 heading
steps: Verify product name is h3 element
Verify heading announced by screen reader

testCases.title: Star rating has accessible label
steps: Verify img has alt like 'Rated X out of 5'
Verify numeric rating and review count accessible

testCases.title: Availability badge has text label not color-only
steps: Locate availability badge (In Stock/Out of Stock)
Verify not conveyed by color alone

testCases.title: Tags/categories accessible to screen readers
steps: Inspect disability type and category tags
Verify tags are in list elements or have accessible structure
Verify screen reader announces tag text

testCases.title: Key Features section uses list markup
steps: Inspect Key Features section in card
Verify features use list elements or structured text

testCases.title: View Details link has accessible name
View Details link keyboard focusable and activatable
Bookmark/Save icon has aria-label and keyboard toggle
steps: Verify aria-label='Save this product' or similar
Tab to icon and press Enter/Space

testCases.title: Card focus outline visible with ≥3:1 contrast
steps: Tab to product card or View Details link

testCases.title: Screen reader announces product name, rating, availability
steps: Navigate to card with screen reader

testCases.title: Hover does not trigger unexpected context change
Focus does not trigger unexpected context change
expectedResults: No unexpected context change on focus

testCases.title: Keyboard navigation between cards is linear
steps: Verify focus moves linearly (card 1 → card 2 → card 3)

testCases.title: Card text contrast meets 4.5:1
steps: Inspect product name, description, price text

testCases.title: Card layout adjusts at 200% zoom without overlap
steps: Verify no content overlap or truncation

testCases.title: Card accessible on mobile viewport
Sign-in modal accessible when unauthenticated user clicks View Details
steps: As unauthenticated user, click View Details

testCases.title: Sign-in modal buttons keyboard accessible
No keyboard traps across product cards
steps: Tab through all visible product cards
Tab past last card to pagination/footer
